how_to_apply: Fill in the prescribed application form printed with the advertisement in BLOCK letters and affix a recent passport size coloured photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed on the form.
Superscribe the envelope 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF WARDEN / CHOWKIDAR-CUM-SWEEPER / HEAD COOK / ASSISTANT COOK FOR BOYS HOSTEL', striking out posts not applicable.
Send to Principal, Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Badadeuli, At-Badadeuli, Po-Sanadeuli, Block-Karanjia, Dist-Mayurbhanj, PIN-757037, Odisha by Speed / Registered post only.
Application must be received by 26-11-2026, 5 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OAV Badadeuli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in OAV Badadeuli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 1 Warden, 1 Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, 1 Head Cook, 2 Assistant Cook.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for OAV Badadeuli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application form printed with the advertisement (pages 5-6)) and send it to Principal, Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Badadeuli, At-Badadeuli, Po-Sanadeuli, Block-Karanjia, Dist-Mayurbhanj, PIN-757037, Odisha, by speed / registered post only, to reach by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Warden: 30 to 60 years; Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper: 21 to 32 years; Head Cook: 30 to 40 years; Assistant Cook: 21 to 32 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs 21,175 per month (including EPF share of Employee & Employer) for Warden, Rs 7,500 per month (including EPF share of Employee & Employer) for Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, Rs 9,000 per month (including EPF share of Employee & Employer) for Head Cook, Rs 6,750 per month (including EPF share of Employee & Employer) for Assistant Cook.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Warden: B.A./B.Sc. from recognized university with at least two years in hostel management; Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper: HSC Examination passed from recognized board; Head Cook and Assistant Cook: no educational qualification printed. All posts male only. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Warden, Head Cook and Assistant Cook must be in a position to stay in the hostel 24x7. Head Cook and Assistant Cook must be well conversant to use LPG. Head Cook and Assistant Cook must have perfect hygiene in dresses while cooking and good cooking habits. Head Cook and Assistant Cook: ability to cook any dishes on time with due care towards hygiene and deliciousness.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Female candidates (all posts are for male candidates).

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: On expiry of one year of engagement, fresh engagement is made with a gap of at least one working day, based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Boys' Hostel (Non-KGBV), Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Badadeuli, Karanjia, Mayurbhanj.
